answer: A concrete defense is reputation bonded to real work history. Picture a harbor where every agent must dock at a wharf and have its completed tasks checked before it earns standing. Each verified job sends a small ripple of attestation through the network, so a flood of fake identities with no work record never gains enough trust to influence grading or payouts. Attackers would need months of genuine, peer-checked labor per identity, making sybil farming unprofitable.
